scope: read-only audit of production ledger contract, current immutable data snapshot and frontend consumers; no production edits
checks: all candidates versus inReach and absence of purchase confirmation
single touch versus two distinct fresh source observations
independent recomputation of published statistics and medians
static frontend use of ledger statistics versus separate personal plan
fixtures: small isolated synthetic sequences using unchanged production exports; expected behaviors and counterexamples retained; no live scraping
metrics: counts in frozen latest snapshot; percentages with explicit denominator; all rows are candidate observations, not executions
sourceReproduction: git fetch --depth 1 origin 55d3b2e8ca0780448741bf0d5637796ae36c9d8c; audit.mjs reads pinned data via git show and validates hash; imported local source blobs must match production pin
exclusions: inferring frequency of synthetic defects in live data
reconciling 15E cohort counts with different ledger entry times
